C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to introduce Ordinance No. 2023­613, adding Chapter 5.97 to Title 5 of the
  Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, imposing regulations on mobile food vending;
  Declare that the Ordinance is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, as it is not a “project” and has no potential to result in a direct
  or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change to the environment. 14 Cal. Code Regs. §
  15378(a). Further, this Ordinance is exempt from CEQA as there is no possibility that this

 C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to introduce Ordinance No. 2023­613, adding Chapter 5.97 to Title 5 of the
  Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, imposing regulations on mobile food vending;
  Declare that the Ordinance is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, as it is not a “project” and has no potential to result in a direct
  or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change to the environment. 14 Cal. Code Regs. §
  15378(a). Further, this Ordinance is exempt from CEQA as there is no possibility that this
  Ordinance or its implementation would have a significant negative effect on the environment. 14
  Cal. Code Regs. § 15061(b)(3); and
  Set Ordinance No. 2023­613 for adoption at the November 14, 2023, City Council meeting.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.
